record.text: Very inconsistent to non-existent. Lots to like about this Raptors squad but they look completely outmatched at the moment. Soft spots that’ll need to be addressed if they’re going to compete beyond the second round of playoffs.

Finch utilized a lineup of Ayo, TSJ, Kuminga, Lyles, Berringer and they outscored the Raptors.

Last year it seemed miraculous that we finally beat the Raptors on our home court, like it was breaking a curse.
Kawhi's shooting will help and his gravity should create better looks for everybody else, but I'm still skeptical about the Raptors' 'take more 3s' plan. Just not enough shooting on this roster.

Wolves have done an excellent job taking away his runways and keeping him away from the rim.

Raptors go 1-10 from 3, Barnes is scoreless and, shockingly, they're down 11 to Minnesota after a quarter

Raptors were outscored 18-3 from 3-point range in the 1st quarter. Minnesota shooting 6-for-8 from distance. Toronto 1-for-10. Barrett has 11 of the Raps' 21 points. He's shooting 5-for-7. Everybody else: 4-for-22. Barnes 0-6 FG and scoreless in 8 minutes. Wolves by 11.
About as horrible a first quarter as the Raptors could have.
